subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the existing history endpoint retain numeric `nextCursor` responses, or may it move clients to opaque generation-aware cursors through a new explicitly versioned/negotiated contract?
rationale: The bounded implementation needs a stable cursor, but selecting the permanent public HTTP and plugin-facing compatibility contract is a maintainer product/API decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Add an additive opaque-cursor contract
options.body: Keep the legacy numeric response available and expose opaque generation-aware pagination only through an explicit versioned or negotiated path.

options.title: Adopt opaque cursors as the endpoint contract
options.body: Approve the breaking response-shape change only with explicit migration documentation and client follow-through.

options.title: Keep this follow-up out of the endpoint
options.body: Retain the existing bounded projection foundation while declining the public HTTP/SSE cursor expansion for now.

recommendation.title: Add an additive opaque-cursor contract
recommendation.body: Keep the legacy numeric response available and expose opaque generation-aware pagination only through an explicit versioned or negotiated path.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bounded-history foundation and its public behavior originated in this area of current main.
